user_query: I need assistance in creating a comprehensive email marketing campaign. Retrieve a list of email contacts from my VerticalResponse account and provide me with the messages sent to these contacts. Additionally, verify the email address 'example@example.com' using the Email Verifier API.

TaskList.description: Retrieve a list of email contacts from the VerticalResponse account.
Fetch the messages sent to the retrieved contacts for the email marketing campaign.
Verify the email address 'example@example.com' using the Email Verifier API.
